description:
Edit a document: parse it, apply a JSON array of edit deltas, and return
the modified blocks (same shape as mcpParse with outputFormat "blocks").
deltas "" or "[]" returns the document unchanged. Office formats only:
docx, pptx, xlsx, odt, odp, ods. Give the document ONE way:
  content + filename: the file base64-encoded, contentEncoding="base64",
    e.g. filename "contract.docx".
  filepath: an https:// URL of a publicly reachable document, or a sample id
    from mcpFormats such as "sample_docx_formatting".
To get a file back, pass the edited blocks' Markdown to mcpConvert.
name: editDocument
title: Edit document
